summary: Strengthen project monitoring, indicator analysis, and results reporting with practical M&E training. Explore the five-day course and enrol.
lede: Integrated monitoring and evaluation links project results, indicator data, and evidence to management decisions. For project managers, M&E officers, and programme analysts, it supports planning monitoring, reviewing delivery, and reporting findings. Participants practise Theory of Change and logical frameworks, indicator design, data quality checks, and Excel analysis, with guided examples of digital data collection and dashboard planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan project results, collect or analyse monitoring data, and use evidence to manage delivery and reporting.
modules: Theory of Change and Project Results
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project planning, implementation, or monitoring is expected. Familiarity with project indicators and routine reporting will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based analysis and guided digital workflow examples.
